It's my programming.|This droid and an OOM command battle droid|}} A '''B1 battle droid''' served in the [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. It was stationed on the [[bridge]] of a [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] during the [[Battle of Rugosa|Ambush on Rugosa]]. {{Droid-stub}} ==Biography== When a space battle ensued above the [[planet]] [[Rugosa]] in [[22 BBY]],{{TCWcanondates|101}} this [[battle droid]] was ordered to shoot down [[Jedi General]] [[Yoda]]'s [[Consular-class light cruiser|''Consular''-class cruiser]]. The [[droid]] also tried to shoot down the [[escape pod]] containing Yoda, but failed to do so. ==Characteristics== Like all [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droids]], it stood at 1.93 [[meter]]s tall. It sported [[bone]]-[[Color|white]] plating and was equipped with an [[E-5 blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== Its first and only appearance was in "[[Ambush]]," the first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which originally aired on [[October 3]], [[2008]]. It was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Ambush}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
